items.title: Anime Stars
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Do you love anime? Well show your love with this new skin pack!

*12 Anime Stars
*2 skins free

items.title: The Pirates
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Y'arrr-ready to go on some swash bucklin' adventures? 

*10 pirates
*1 free skin

items.title: PvP Fighters
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Get ready to battle it out with these skins!

*12 PvP Fighters
*1 skin free

items.title: Spleef
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Battle against your friends and become the last one on top! 
Play standard Spleef on 5 uniquely different arenas, or play Mega Spleef to crank it up a notch! 

*2 gamemodes 
*5 arenas

items.title: Candy Island
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Modern cookie houses, huge ice cream mountains, and even rich chocolate rivers are only a few sugary goodies you’ll have on your dream survival candy island. What are you waiting for? Your sweet tooth paradise adventure is calling your name!

- Starting loot
- Made for candy lovers

items.title: Dark Demons
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Rule the Nether as one of these powerful dark demons.

items.title: Dragon Secret Base
items.creator: A30x1
items.description: A long time ago, the dragons lived together with the sheeps, pigs and villagers... But now, all that remains from this time are the ruins of the draconic civilization, explore an epic dragon secret base full of places to explore!

items.title: Long Weapons
items.creator: Maca Designs
items.description:
Wow, what happened? The weapons have grown so much longer, they're at least 5 times my size!

- Extremely long swords, axes, hoes, shovels, pickaxes, tridents and shields!
- A cozy castle, with very tall towers
- 5 resourceful sword statues

items.title: Medieval Rush
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Prepare to battle in the epic new treasure defender map solo or with your friends! Don't forget to equip, upgrade and maximize your gear!
Only few try, and fewer succeed! Careful though, these mob bosses are ready to destroy the loot and see you and the treasure face certain destruction!
* Shops!
* Skins!
* Multiplayer fun!
* Upgradable gear!
* Rush, protect & conquer!

items.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
items.creator: Gamemode One
items.description: Sonic the Hedgehog races into Minecraft at supersonic speeds! Sprint, roll, and spring off enemies through iconic zones, with infinite gameplay. Master the thrilling abilities of Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, and more! Compete with friends for high scores. Unlock achievements, characters, new zones, and a challenging Eggman Mode! Includes popular skins.
items.changelog:
- 5 brand new skins! Super Shadow, Maria Robotnik, Gerald Robotnik, Emerl, and Gemerl.
- Various bug fixes.

items.title: Craftable: Treehouses
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Gather some materials, find the perfect spot, and craft your very own treehouse! Go wild and build an entire city, or keep it simple and find a nice cosy place for you and a friend.

- Includes 10 craftable styles (including rainbow style, Creeper and TNT, plane crash, and more)
- Easy to use Craftidex to browse the recipes
- Nudge, rotate, and undo support
- By 57Digital

items.title: Treeple
items.creator: The World Foundry
items.description: Tree people! What secrets lie hidden in the dense forest? Who lives deep in the woodland? Is that a village high up in the trees? Make the natural world your adventure with this perfect set of classic skins!

items.title: Royal Teens
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Wow, look at these brand new crowns! Everyone knows that no king or queen is complete without one!

- 8 royal teen skins!
- With a wide variety of designs and outfits, you can find the perfect skin, and crown, that suits you!

items.title: Royal Chroma
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These rainbow chroma skins have dazzling new crowns! Perfect for any king or queen!

- 8 rainbow crown skins!
- With a wide variety of patterns and colors, you can find the perfect design that suits you!

items.title: SkyXGrid
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Try to survive in a psychedelic environment... Explore a universe made of giant crosses floating in the void, collect resources and discover all its secrets!
Will you overcome this challenge?

- A HUGE custom world!
- Overworld & Nether available!
- Tons of fun alone or with your friends!
- By Pixelusion & bidule995

items.title: Toxic Island
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
You're stranded on an island surrounded by an ocean of toxic water! How long can you last with limited supplies and resources?

- 1 island with toxic water
- By inPixel

items.title: Summer Vibes
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
The summer is finally here and it's time to upgrade your outfit! Grab your favorite skin out of a selection of 12 trendy skins and be the best you can! No matter what activity, be it playing football or winning games in skywars, you will be the center of attention with these colorful and cute outfits!

- 12 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Dream Team Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
The summer is upon us and it's time to refresh your style! Join the dream team with your friends and venture forth in search of epic adventures while looking trendy and cool! No matter your style, there is something for everyone! What are you waiting for!

- 12 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Fashion Frenzy
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Love to follow the latest fashion trends? to be the coolest on the server? Well, do so with these teens! Be the first to rock the new style and inspire others to express their wildest ideas! 

- 12 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Kawaii Anime
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Become super Kawaii with this cute anime pack! Pick from a selection of different cute skins, and show off your new style!

- 11 skins
- By inPixel & SeaStory

items.title: Divine Armor
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
The power to change the tide of battle is in your hands. Embrace this divine armor bestowed unto you. Grasp it and enforce your will. With great power comes great responsibility.

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Fantasy, battle attire!

items.title: Giant Mobs
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Have you ever wanted every mob to be supersized in Minecraft? Well, we have got the map for you! Roam around killing these giants that walk among the land and find the spawners to finally restore the world to what it once was!

items.title: Slime Parkour
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Slime Parkour is a fun parkour map around the bounciest block in Minecraft. The slime block! This green block is bouncy and perfect for jumping. Have fun parkouring with well-designed and free-flowing maps with a little extra bounce! Play by yourself or with friends today!

- Convenient checkpoints
- Single and multiplayer compatible
